# hunch doctor: examples

`doctor` answers "why did my PR get no review?" using your `gh` login. Captured against the Hunch repository itself.

<!-- case: doctor-local -->
### Not a GitHub repository

```sh
npx @kelbie/hunch doctor
```

Exit code **0**.

stdout:

```text

  ? GitHub remote          no github.com origin; only local review applies here

Nothing is missing that Hunch can see from here.
```
